;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)]], [[Afghan peace process]]
**A seven-day "reduction of violence" between [[United States Armed Forces|United States troops]], [[Afghan Armed Forces|Afghan troops]], and the [[Taliban]] is due to start at midnight local time (19:30 UTC). If the partial [[Ceasefire|truce]] is successful, a US–Taliban agreement on withdrawing American troops would be signed on February 29. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/u-s-taliban-reduction-violence-start-friday-ahead-broader-deal-n1140206 (NBC News)]
*[[Kashmir conflict]]
**India and Pakistan have engaged in a military confrontation across the ''de facto'' border in [[Kashmir]]; [[Indian Armed Forces|Indian]] and [[Pakistan Armed Forces|Pakistani]] forces [[2019 India–Pakistan border skirmishes|exchanged fire]] near the [[Line of Control]] (LoC) in [[Kupwara district]], [[Jammu and Kashmir (union territory)|Jammu and Kashmir]]. One Pakistani soldier died in the exchange of fire. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news/indian-forces-respond-to-ceasefire-violation-by-pakistan-in-jammu-and-kashmir/story-6MexMQaEkfMVDSz59WGvfP.html (''Hindustan Times'')]
*A 64-year-old woman was killed after being attacked by a man with a hammer in [[Toronto]], [[Canada]]. The victim was chosen at random. The attacker left a note on the victim's body, expressing support for terrorism. He was arrested and charged with terrorism offences. [https://beta.canada.com/news/toronto/toronto-man-faces-terrorism-charge-after-allegedly-killing-woman-on-street-with-hammer/wcm/512d58b6-3531-4afb-8f5c-05aa24c613a2/amp/ (Canada.com)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
***[[Italy]] confirms 18 more coronavirus cases in the country, bringing the confirmed cases to twenty-one. All eighteen are Italian citizens. [https://www.corriere.it/cronache/20_febbraio_21/coronavirus-italia-cosa-sappiamo-casi-codogno-lombardia-27fa736c-548b-11ea-9196-da7d305401b7.shtml (''Corriere della Sera'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic lockdown in Italy]]
****Eleven municipalities of the [[province of Lodi]] are put on [[lockdown]] to contain the coronavirus pandemic, leaving around 50,000 people affected. [https://metro.co.uk/2020/02/25/towns-italy-lockdown-coronavirus-12298246/ (''Metro'')]
**[[Israel]] and [[Lebanon]] report their first cases of 2019-nCoV coronavirus. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/02/cloneofcloneofcloneofcloneofcloneof2002152244372-200220231446112.html (Al Jazeera)]
**[[North Korea]] cancels this year's [[Pyongyang Marathon]] due to concerns about coronavirus. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/02/cloneofcloneofcloneofcloneofcloneof2002152244372-200220231446112.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Law and crime
*[[Prime Minister of Lesotho]] [[Tom Thabane]] fails to appear in court for the murder of his former wife, and his son says he has traveled to [[South Africa]] to see a doctor. Police warn that if he does not return, they will issue an [[arrest warrant]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-lesotho-politics/lesotho-pm-due-in-court-over-first-wifes-death-travels-to-south-africa-idUSKBN20F19L (Reuters)] [https://www.iol.co.za/news/africa/lesotho-police-if-thomas-thabane-tries-to-flee-justice-we-will-issue-arrest-warrant-43134096 (''Independent Online'')]
*The [[Constitutional Court of Thailand]] orders the [[Future Forward Party]] to be dissolved. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/thai-court-orders-popular-opposition-party-dissolved-69120382 (ABC News)]
*[[Mexico]] [[Extradition|extradites]] [[Rubén Oseguera González]], the son of [[Nemesio Oseguera Cervantes]], to the [[United States]] to face drug charges. Cervantes is the leader of the [[Jalisco New Generation Cartel]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/mexico-extradites-son-jalisco-cartel-face-us-charges-69125126 (ABC News)]
*[[Wells Fargo]] is set to pay $3 billion over their 2016 scandal of creating fake accounts in customers' names. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/all/wells-fargo-pay-3-billion-over-fake-account-scandal-n1140541 (NBC News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Dominican Republic municipal elections]]
**The major opposition party [[Modern Revolutionary Party|PRM]] asked for protection for its presidential security chief. [https://dominicantoday.com/dr/local/2020/02/21/opposition-party-wants-protection-for-candidates-security-chief/ (''Dominican Today'')]
**The Protest in Black continues into the fourth day. [https://dominicantoday.com/dr/local/2020/02/21/a-4th-protest-in-black-in-dominican-republic/ (''Dominican Today'')]
**[[Attorney General of the Republic (Dominican Republic)|Attorney General]] [[Jean Alain Rodríguez Sánchez]] launches a plan to [[Sequestration (law)|sequester]] the [[Ministry of Justice, Immigration and National Security (Dominica)|Justice Ministry]] for [[Partisan (politics)|partisan purposes]]. [https://dominicantoday.com/dr/local/2020/02/21/dominican-rep-ag-aims-to-sequester-the-justice-ministry/ (''Dominican Today'')]

*[[2020 Iranian legislative election]]
**[[Elections in Iran|Parliamentary elections]] are being held in [[Iran]]. The election is criticized for the barring of around 9,000 candidates, thus raising the concerns of an unusual low [[voter turnout]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/iran-polls-open-in-parliamentary-elections/a-52457553 (DW)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/feb/21/irans-leaders-warn-low-turnout-in-election-will-boost-trump (''The Guardian'')]
